title: Options
summary: Everything the options window (P) changes: graphics per device, sound and the radio, the interface, the controls, trades and privacy.

blocks.text: Visual quality (Low, Medium, High, Extreme) and effects detail (Low, Medium, High). They are kept per kind of device: a phone starts on Low, a gamepad on Medium, a computer on High. Show or hide the staff's event visuals (shard rain, party lights) and the other summoners' undead.
blocks.html:
• Visual quality (Low, Medium, High, Extreme) and effects detail (Low, Medium, High). They are kept per kind of device: a phone starts on Low, a gamepad on Medium, a computer on High.
  • Show or hide the staff's event visuals (shard rain, party lights) and the other summoners' undead.

blocks.text: Music, effects and interface volumes. The radio : the game's own playlist, or your own list of up to 30 tracks.
blocks.html:
• Music, effects and interface volumes.
  • The radio: the game's own playlist, or your own list of up to 30 tracks.

blocks.text: Interface size (80% to 120%) and text size (Normal, Large, Larger). Labels of the interface in the city only or always; show or hide the status bar, the action bar, the party panel, the dungeon map, the radio and the city tracker; damage numbers; camera shake. Language: automatic, English or French.
blocks.html:
• Interface size (80% to 120%) and text size (Normal, Large, Larger).
  • Labels of the interface in the city only or always; show or hide the status bar, the action bar, the party panel, the dungeon map, the radio and the city tracker; damage numbers; camera shake.
  • Language: automatic, English or French.

blocks.text: Sprint: hold, toggle or always. Change the keys and the gamepad buttons; move and resize the touch buttons. Put the weapon back on the back when idle.
blocks.html:
• Sprint: hold, toggle or always.
  • Change the keys and the gamepad buttons; move and resize the touch buttons.
  • Put the weapon back on the back when idle.

blocks.text: Trades off: no trade request reaches you ( Trading ). Anonymous : on the leaderboards and the podiums you show as ??? with an unknown statue. Hide parts of your profile card from the others: gear, stats, skills, records. Play with your own Roblox avatar instead of your awakened's look (with the Own avatar game pass).
blocks.html:
• Trades off: no trade request reaches you (Trading).
  • Anonymous: on the leaderboards and the podiums you show as ??? with an unknown statue.
  • Hide parts of your profile card from the others: gear, stats, skills, records.
  • Play with your own Roblox avatar instead of your awakened's look (with the Own avatar game pass).

blocks.text: The options can wipe your profile for good: you must type DELETE to confirm. A guild leader with members must hand the guild over first.
